title: Tiered circuit entropy stabilizer to reduce repeated reopen oscillations
author: Elliot Chen
release_notes: Hotfix: Add tiered circuit stabilizer with probabilistic cooloff to reduce rapid circuit reopen/close oscillations observed under bursty regional failover; introduces new metrics and a toggleable feature flag.
description: Motivation: In recent incidents we observed rapid circuit reopen/close oscillations when regional capacity fluctuated, which led to cascading SLO degradations. This PR introduces a Tiered Circuit Entropy Stabilizer: a lightweight state machine that applies probabilistic cooloff, tiered reopen windows, and jittered reopen attempts to prevent synchronized flips across nodes. Design: 1) Introduce three tiers for circuits: healthy, guarded, quarantined. 2) On transition to guarded/quarantined, attach a randomized cooloff window derived from a configurable entropy seed to avoid herd reopen. 3) Reopen attempts use exponentially increasing jitter and a capped backoff to avoid saturating downstream capacity. 4) Penalize circuits that reopen too frequently by increasing their tier severity. 5) Emit new telemetry: circuit_entropy.seed, circuit_tier.transition, circuit_reopen.attempts, circuit_reopen.jitter_ms. Backwards compatibility: feature gated behind runtime flag "tiered_circuit_entropy" defaulting to true for release; config bump in values-stability.yaml included for Dedicated and Private installs. Migration and rollout: deploy to canary zone for 24h with synthetic replay (scripts/loadtest/oscillation-replay.yaml), monitor the new metrics and SLO regression alerts, then promote. Testing: unit tests for state transitions, fuzz test harness added to reproducer, and an integration scenario that simulates regional KV drain and verifies no more than 2 rapid reopen cycles within 5 minutes. Checklist: - [x] Implementation of stabilizer state machine - [x] Unit + integration tests - [x] Telemetry hooks + metric names - [x] Helm values and feature flag - [x] Canary loadtest playbook - [x] Docs: upgrade guide and operational notes Impact: reduces probability of synchronized reopen by introducing entropy and tiered backoff; expected to lower incident recurrence frequency and SLO violation blast radius. Rollback plan: disable feature flag or revert to previous binary; metrics allow quick detection of regressions. Related: Linear ENG-1987, support ticket SUP-4123.
